blind.B1: Yes. Abstract: HFD/DMBA steatosis-associated liver cancer mouse model, treadmill 18 m/min 20 min/day; livers of exercise vs non-exercise groups profiled. Exercise-carrying samples: the 8 HFD exercise samples (non-tumor 4, tumor 4; titles 'Exercise'). The 4 ND non-exercise mice have no exercise arm.
blind.B2: Exercise vs non-exercise liver in HFD/DMBA mice; packet A gives 4 vs 4 per tissue (non-tumor, tumor). The abstract gives no n and no per-group sample counts (abstract only, no full text).
blind.B3: Abstract does not say. Packet A: titles mouse1-4 within each group; tumor and non-tumor tissue probably come from the same mice, but no field links them across groups (candidate keys: 0/20 linked). Within one tissue stratum each mouse is sampled once, so no repeat there.
blind.B5: Abstract states no DEG rule and no counts. Only: Per1/Cry2 up, E2F1/c-Myc target genes down, E2F1/Myc mRNA unchanged.

checks.evidence: Exercise arm present (8 HFD exercise samples, titles/characteristics_ch1.4.treatment); analysis ran two exercise contrasts.
ex/tis derived from characteristics_ch1.4.treatment, 4 vs 4 per tissue; control is HFD non-exercise of same tissue (not ND, which is explicitly rejected); ND not used, stated.
contrasts EX (treatment) vs NE (control); Per1/Cry2 positive log2FC match abstract 'upregulated in exercise'.
Separate fits per tissue stratum; one sample per mouse within a stratum, so no block needed. Tumor/non-tumor link across tissues is undocumented and not used.
Paper silent (abstract only). Fits were stratified per tissue, ~ex; a joint model with tissue was not reported. Open policy question.
All male, same age, euthanized same day, one sequencing platform; no batch/run field recorded; covariance gate not_required and says so.
featureCounts integer counts (integer_fraction 1.0, library 16-20 M); GEO 'TPM' discrepancy recorded; DESeq2 appropriate.
Paper rule unknown; padj<0.05 workflow default labelled as such, raw p<0.05 shown as audit.
No paper counts claimed; HANDBACK says comparison rests on abstract only and records the non-tumor MYC_TARGETS NES>0 direction contradiction.

human_items: Joint model (tissue + exercise) versus per-tissue fits is an open policy question; the paper (abstract only) is silent.
Non-tumor liver Hallmark MYC_TARGETS up with exercise contradicts the abstract; recorded as caveat, consider checking against the full text.
summary: 该案例通过。运动臂存在（HFD运动组共8个样本），在非肿瘤和肿瘤组织内分别比较运动组与HFD非运动组（4 vs 4），方向、对照、矩阵与方法均合理。仅有摘要，论文的阈值和DEG数无法核对，已如实标注；非肿瘤肝中MYC靶基因方向与摘要不符已记录为注意事项。
